international.title: Australian politics live: Blyth did not ‘feel safe’ in the Liberal party before One Nation defection; ‘coal must be replaced’, Bowen says
international.summary: Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Pauline Hanson has released a statement this morning welcoming South Australian senator Leah Blyth to her party . Blyth is the second high-profile federal defection from the Coalition to One Nation – after Barnaby Joyce . Senator Blyth will be One Nation’s first South Australian Senator and will build on One Nation’s expanding support within the state. My team and I are delighted to welcome Senator Blyth to sit in the Senate with One Nation. We are facing at the next election clearly a coalition of the Liberals, Nationals and One Nation, with all the baggage that each of these parties brings to the table. They’re all anti-worker, they’re all extreme … this demonstrates, I think, more disunity in the Liberal party under Angus Taylor . Continue reading...
